summary: A candidate who cannot pay the filing fee may instead hand in signatures worth the fee.
realLife: A filing-fee petition is allowed, and its valid signatures must total at least the fee in dollars.
sources: Washington Secretary of State, File for Office: https://www.sos.wa.gov/elections/candidates/filing-resources/file-office
inGame: the petition and fee records the filing already keeps.

turns.what: The candidate pays the fee and needs no petition.
turns.writesBack: a paid fee on the filing record

turns.pulledBy: the petition count against the date
